description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) of different MADLLM configurations across various datasets. The horizontal axis lists the datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score, ranging from 60% to 100%. The chart includes four sets of bars, each representing a different configuration of MADLLM: MADLLM, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The bars are color-coded: green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, blue for MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and orange for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The F1 Scores for each configuration vary across the datasets, with some configurations performing better on certain datasets than others. The chart does not include any additional annotations or visual emphasis on specific bars.
